briefTitle: Study With ABBV-CLS-484 in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of >= 12 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Laboratory values meeting protocol criteria.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General laboratory values are not specified with explicit cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: QT interval corrected for heart rate < 470 msec (using Fridericia's correction), and no clinically significant electrocardiographic findings.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTc interval check is not part of the allowed typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease defined by RECIST 1.1 criteria.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have received at least 1 prior systemic anticancer therapy for the indication being considered.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lines and therapy requirements vary across multiple study arms and dose expansion cohorts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have received at least 1 prior line containing PD-1/PD-L1 targeted therapy with a best response by RECIST v1.1 of CR/PR/stable (any duration) or stable disease (for greater than 6 months); AND Must have been previously treated with 1 or more prior lines of therapy in the locally advanced or metastatic setting with the following tumor types: Relapsed/refractory HNSCC, Relapsed/refractory NSCLC, Advanced ccRCC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Dose expansion cohorts have conditional and multi-part prior line and response criteria that cannot be expressed with a single typed rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For the following tumor types, subject must have received at least 1 prior line containing PD-1/PD-L1 targeted therapy with response by RECIST v1.1 of CR/PR (any duration) or stable disease (for greater than 6 months): Relapsed HNSCC, Relapsed NSCLC, Relapsed Advanced ccRCC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Combination dose expansion criteria depend on specific tumor types and response categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For the following tumor types, subject must have received at least 1 prior line containing PD-1/PD-L1 targeted therapy and have had disease progression with PD-1/PD-L1 targeted therapy: Locally Advanced or metastatic MSI-H tumors
